title.en: the corner store opens at the cosmopolitan.
title.de: the corner store öffnet im cosmopolitan.

line.en: the new york restaurant opens on the cosmopolitan's third floor today, in the old blue ribbon room. a first table after work.
line.de: das new yorker restaurant öffnet heute im dritten stock des cosmopolitan, im ehemaligen blue-ribbon-raum. ein erster tisch nach der arbeit.
line.tr: new york restoranı bugün cosmopolitan'ın üçüncü katında, eski blue ribbon mekânında açılıyor. iş sonrası ilk masa.

sparks.why: The Corner Store opens at The Cosmopolitan on Mon 9 Nov, per Las Vegas Review-Journal (neon.reviewjournal.com); the opening hour is not confirmed, 18:00 is a suggestion.
